## Before you touch anything
- Do not branch, commit or open a PR from this checkout without fetching first — local HEAD 72fd07f is 16 commits behind origin/main afe139e, so the linear-light/sRGB dark-render fix, the closed-form SpectralNorm fix …
- Do not copy code out of Parsec into any other repo in this org: it is the only GPL-3.0 code here, so the copyleft runs outward — copying into Parsec is the safe direction, copying out is not.
- Do not commit anything here you would not publish: this is the org's only public repo, the pre-release scrub used `git rm` rather than a history rewrite (so `git show 619b222^:fold_prospector.py` still resolves …
- Do not insert a ComboBoxItem into the middle of MainWindow.axaml's FractalSelector — MainWindow.axaml.cs OnFractalChanged maps raw SelectedIndex 1..22 onto FractalType with index 0 falling through `_ => …

## Build traps
- `dotnet build Parsec.sln` silently does not build the application: this checkout's Parsec.sln lists only Parsec.Core, Parsec.Rendering, Parsec.Rendering.Gpu and Parsec.Cli …
- README.md's run command omits the src/ prefix — the real path is src/Parsec.App/Parsec.App.csproj, and the README's version fails from the repo root.
- The build succeeds on SDK 10 but nothing runs without .NET 9 ("You must install or update .NET ... Framework: 'Microsoft.NETCore.App', version '9.0.0'"), so prefix DOTNET_ROLL_FORWARD=Major to run anything here.

## Conventions
- File-scoped namespaces in all 119 C# files; every csproj sets Nullable=enable, ImplicitUsings=enable, LangVersion=latest …
- Design rationale lives in XML doc <remarks> blocks and in GLSL header comments, not in separate documents …
